title: Model request record
description: What the framework RECORDS about a model call before it happens: who (role, model), which prompt/playbook versions, which visibility policy (the role allow-list), which response contract the output must satisfy, and a hash of the exact context bundle sent. These are the version stamps the trajectory log needs so any decision is reproducible against its inputs.

prompt_version.description: sha256[:16] of the system prompt file actually sent (model_boundary.prompt_version)

playbook_id.description: e.g. oracle_manipulation.v1, or null when no playbook matched

visibility_policy.description: the role's field allow-list name, e.g. ["critic-allowlist-v1"]

response_schema.description: the contract the model's output must satisfy (model_response.schema.json definitions)

context_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical serialization of the context bundle actually sent
